# Manifest Format

A service's Manifest is one JSON document (`format` 1): its bounded contexts, their aggregates with the commands and events they speak, their subscriptions, the framework's error codes, and the JSON Schema 2020-12 of every payload under `$defs`. A module's fragment (`META-INF/wow/manifest/<module>.json`) has the same shape without `service`. This outline of every object and its keys is generated from the code that writes it, [`ManifestTree`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/blob/main/api/manifest/src/main/kotlin/me/ahoo/wow/manifest/ManifestTree.kt).

Wow reads a schema of `$defs`, the compiler's and a hand-written one alike (a `schemaOverrides` entry, or a schema a fragment holds already), by a rule that differs from JSON Schema's default, which allows any property a schema does not refuse: an object schema that names its class (`x-wow-class`) or lists `properties`, and has no `additionalProperties`, is closed, so a masked read answers only the properties it declares ([Where masking stops](../guide/queries#where-masking-stops)). One with `additionalProperties`, a map's or a class's that Jackson writes more of than its properties (`@JsonAnyGetter`, `@JsonAppend`), and one with neither class nor properties, a free object, are open.

What the writer leaves out:

Absent optional values (a null description, unknown `produces`, `derives`, `schedules` or `transformsTo`, a fragment's service, a subscription's `retry` or `job`) are left out, not written as null, and so are a subscription source's `nullableState` and a command's `mounted`, `system` and `internal` when false, an aggregate's `ownership` when it is `OWNER`, the default, its `idSource` when it is `ASSIGNED`, the default, its `retired` events and its `access` attributes when it has none, an access attribute's `multiple` when false, and the `requires` of the Manifest, a context or an aggregate when it has none (written sorted and distinct, so the Manifest is byte-stable).

## `Manifest`

- `format`
- `requires`
- `service`: object; left out when absent or at its default
  - `name`
  - `version`
- `contexts`: array of [`Context`](#context)
- `errors`: array of [`Error`](#error)
- `$defs`

## `Context`

- `name`
- `requires`
- `description`
- `aggregates`: array of [`Aggregate`](#aggregate)
- `subscriptions`: array of [`Subscription`](#subscription)
- `published`: array of objects
  - `aggregate`
  - `topic`
  - `includeState`
  - `revealsDisplay`: left out when absent or at its default
- `errors`: array of [`Error`](#error)
- `commands`: array of [`Command`](#command); left out when absent or at its default
- `routes`: array of [`ServiceRoute`](#serviceroute); left out when absent or at its default

## `ServiceRoute`

- `name`
- `route`
- `parameters`: array of objects; left out when absent or at its default
  - `name`
  - `in`
  - `schema`
  - `required`
- `request`
- `response`
- `responseOptional`: left out when absent or at its default
- `errors`: left out when absent or at its default
- `description`
- `deprecated`: left out when absent or at its default

## `Command`

- `name`
- `aliases`
- `schema`
- `creation`
- `produces`
- `routes`: array of [`Route`](#route)
- `mounted`: left out when absent or at its default
- `system`: left out when absent or at its default
- `internal`: left out when absent or at its default
- `transformsTo`
- `idProperty`
- `occurredAtProperty`
- `description`

## `Error`

- `code`
- `status`
- `description`
- `retry`: left out when absent or at its default
- `retryAfter`

## `Aggregate`

- `name`
- `requires`
- `description`
- `state`: object
  - `schema`
  - `fingerprint`
- `snapshot`: object
  - `enabled`
  - `stateRevision`: left out when absent or at its default
- `commands`: array of [`Command`](#command)
- `events`: array of objects
  - `name`
  - `aliases`
  - `revision`
  - `schema`
  - `description`
- `queries`: array of objects
  - `model`
  - `routes`: array of [`Route`](#route)
- `schedules`
- `ownership`: left out when absent or at its default
- `retired`: left out when absent or at its default
- `idSource`: left out when absent or at its default
- `access`: array of objects; left out when absent or at its default
  - `name`
  - `type`
  - `multiple`: left out when absent or at its default

## `Route`

- `method`
- `path`

## `Subscription`

- `name`
- `kind`
- `source`: object
  - `context`
  - `aggregates`
  - `events`
  - `eventSchemas`: left out when absent or at its default
  - `nullableState`: left out when absent or at its default
- `function`: object
  - `kind`
  - `context`
  - `processor`
  - `name`
- `derives`
- `rejected`
- `committed`
- `calls`
- `start`: left out when absent or at its default
- `schedules`
- `retry`: object; left out when absent or at its default
  - `maxAttempts`
  - `initialBackoff`
  - `maxBackoff`
  - `timeout`
  - `recoverable`
  - `unrecoverable`
  - `systemic`
  - `multiplier`
- `job`: object; left out when absent or at its default
  - `name`
  - `cron`
  - `timeZone`
  - `scope`
  - `misfire`
